title: Three Years and One Short Plan
subtitle: 可持续发展 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 可持续发展（人与自然·环境保护·可持续发展）
meta: 主题语境：可持续发展（人与自然·环境保护·可持续发展）　|　核心词汇：prosperity　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 prosperity 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the planner ① brought the prosperity that no citizen in the district would have described, and he said the bringing was the whole of the year. The ② prosperity, meaning the wealth itself and not the plan, ran three years and stayed undescribed in the book; prosperity, he said, is the only thing in a district that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ sort of prosperity in that district had the same short plan beside it, and the ④ prosperity at the far square, meaning the plot they kept for the children to measure and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Prosperity, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the planner said the describing is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the prosperity was the whole of the matter, meaning the peace and not the wealth. The ⑥ prosperity, meaning the peace and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; prosperity, he said, is either something you bring or the only word that means both wealth and a peace. He said the peace is the part they remember.

By 1992 the ⑦ prosperity had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short plan. The ⑧ prosperity of the whole thing, the planner wrote in March, was one district and three years of describing; prosperity, he said, is either the plot at the far square or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ prosperity I remember is the prosperity described in the report, which closed in 1994 and is still described as the quietest in the district. ⑩ Prosperity, my mother said in 1996, is the only thing that improves by being described; all prosperity, she said, is a peace that has agreed to look like wealth. She said the peace was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 繁荣；兴旺（指街区里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 繁荣；兴旺（指那分繁荣本身，与薄薄的图纸相对）
C. 固定搭配：bring the prosperity 带来这一分繁荣
D. n. 繁荣；兴旺（指留给孩子们丈量的那一块）
E. n. 繁荣之事（抽象总称，指一处街区的繁荣之事）
F. n. 繁荣；兴旺（指规划报告里写到、被描述的那一分）
G. n. 繁荣、安乐（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 安乐（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: brought the prosperity that no citizen in the district would have described
The prosperity, meaning the wealth itself and not the plan
Every sort of prosperity in that district
the prosperity at the far square
the prosperity was the whole of the matter
the prosperity had become a line in a report
The prosperity of the whole thing

answers.why: bring the prosperity 意为“带来这一分繁荣”，1987 年那位规划员把街区里没有一位市民肯描述的一分繁荣做了一遍。
prosperity 意为“繁荣；兴旺”，指那分繁荣本身而不是薄薄的图纸，它经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被描述。
prosperity 意为“繁荣；兴旺”，指街区里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一张薄薄的图纸。
prosperity 意为“繁荣；兴旺”，指最远那处广场的留给孩子们丈量的那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
prosperity 意为“繁荣、安乐”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这分安乐就是那件事的全部。
prosperity 意为“安乐”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那分繁荣，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
prosperity 意为“繁荣；兴旺”，指规划报告里写到、被描述的那一分，到 1992 年这一分成了规划报告里的一行。
prosperity 意为“繁荣之事”，规划员三月写道，整件事的繁荣之事是一处街区和三个年份的描述。
prosperity 意为“繁荣；兴旺”，我记得的是规划报告里描述过的那一分，1994 年落成了，至今仍被说成街区里最安静的一分。
prosperity 为抽象总称，母亲 1996 年说，繁荣是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的繁荣。
